sloka: ऋते नियोगात् सामर्थ्यम् अवबोद्धुम् न शक्यते ।सहसा विनियोगो हि दोषवान् प्रतिभाति मे ॥६-१७-५४॥।।
transliteration: ṛte niyogāt sāmarthyam avaboddhum na śakyate ।sahasā viniyogo hi doṣavān pratibhāti me ॥6-17-54॥।।

translations.english: "When entrusted with duty one's capability will be known. It is not possible to appoint him for duty inconsiderately without understanding (his capacity) as it will be faulty."
translations.hindi: बिना कोई काम सोपे तो किसी की हित अनहित भावना का पता चल नहीं सकता । साथ ही सहसा कोई काम सोप देना भी मेरी समझ में ठीक नहीं हे
